_readme: Where the LVR token lives, one entry per chain id. The audit and top-up tools read this
instead of taking an address on the command line, so the address exists in one place.
deployBlock is the block the token was deployed in: the invariant audit scans from there,
which is what keeps a whole-history check affordable. owner is who owned the token when
it was deployed; both tools compare it with owner() on chain and fail if it has drifted.
Keys must be decimal chain ids. Anything not matching /^\d+$/ is ignored, which is how
